categories.description: Essential collocations and idioms for speaking & writing tasks about spending, saving and economy.

items.example: Being a student taught me how crucial it is to live within my means and avoid unnecessary debt.
Supermarkets often place sweets near the counter to encourage impulse buying among shoppers.
Setting aside an emergency fund provides a reliable financial safety net during tough times.
I felt instant buyer's remorse after splurging on an expensive smartwatch I barely use.

items.meaning_az: Gələcək və ya çətin gün üçün pul yığmaq (idiom)
items.example: My parents always advised me to save for a rainy day rather than spending every penny.
Prudent financial management is essential for young professionals navigating high living costs.

categories.description: Descriptive adjectives and collocations for outdoor spaces, landscapes and botanical sanctuaries.

items.meaning_az: Sakit və dinc yaşıl vaha / istirahət məkanı
items.example: The botanical garden is a tranquil green oasis right in the heart of our bustling city.
People visit national parks primarily to escape the daily hustle and bustle of modern life.
The estate boasts a sprawling acreage with century-old trees and winding pathways.
The temperature-controlled conservatory shelters hundreds of exotic flora and fauna species.
Taking a brisk morning stroll through lush pine woods completely rejuvenates my mind.
The serene architecture of the Japanese pavilion left a lasting impression on all visitors.

categories.description: Connectors that boost Coherence & Cohesion and Lexical Resource in Speaking Part 3 and Writing Task 2.

items.phrase: Without a shadow of a doubt
items.meaning_az: Zərrə qədər şübhə olmadan / birmənalı olaraq
items.example: Without a shadow of a doubt, investing in green technology yields long-term economic gains.
It is widely acknowledged that early childhood immersion shapes cognitive flexibility.
In stark contrast to rural tranquility, metropolitan living induces chronic cognitive overload.

items.phrase: To strike a balance between X and Y
items.meaning_az: X ilə Y arasında tarazlıq yaratmaq
items.example: Urban planners must strike a delicate balance between commercial expansion and ecology.
